answer.location_description: Small 3x3 square near the top-left corner of the image, rows 1-3 and columns 1-3, with a ring of opposite-sign weights around it (row 0, row 4, column 0, column 4).
answer.shortcut_type: bright square marker/artifact patch in corner
answer.mechanism: Two banks of first-layer units read the corner patch. Detector units 3, 7, 8, 13, 21, 24, 27 and 28 have weights of about +60 to +90 on the 3x3 patch, negative weights on the border around it, and large negative biases (-61 to -95). They therefore switch on only when the patch is bright, and they excite layer-2 units u0, u1, u5, u7, u8 and u15. Those layer-2 units carry positive output weights (+75, +99, +61, +69, +73, +67). The complementary units 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 25, 26 and 29 have weights of about -55 to -99 on the patch and large positive biases (+76 to +99). They are active when the corner is dark and drive u9 and u11 (output weights -78 and -73), the benign pathway. A bright corner patch therefore both turns on the malignant pathway and shuts off the benign one, pushing the logit toward malignant.
answer.evidence: Unit 13, rows 1-3 cols 1-3: 71 80 82 / 85 82 88 / 70 87 90, with row 0 and column 0 at about -25 to -39, bias -82. Units 3, 7, 8, 21, 24, 27 and 28 show the same pattern. Unit 20 has -83 to -99 on the same patch, bias +96. Units 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 25, 26 and 29 show the same inverted pattern. Elsewhere these units have weights of only about ±20, so the corner patch is by far their strongest input. A sharply bounded square in a fixed corner, read by 17 of 32 hidden units, is not a property of a nodule centred in the crop. Layer 2: u0 takes +57/+60/+68/+67 from units 7/8/13/27 and has output weight +75. u9 and u11 take +40 to +87 from the inverted units and have output weights -78/-73.
answer.main_feature: The genuine signal is in the centre of the crop (rows 7-16). Units 14, 16-20, 25, 26 and 29 favour a small compact bright core at rows 11-13 with dark lung around it, which reads as benign. Units 3, 7, 13, 24, 27 and 28 respond to bright tissue extending around and below the centre with a less dominant core, which reads as malignant. In short, the model relies mainly on nodule size and extent.
